title: Parzen window likelihood estimate has high variance in high dimensions
description: The method used to evaluate the generative model by fitting a Gaussian Parzen window to samples has high variance and does not perform well in high-dimensional spaces.
canonical_description: likelihood estimation via density estimation on generated samples has high variance and poor performance in high-dimensional spaces

evidence.quote: This method of estimating the likelihood has somewhat high variance and does not perform well in high dimensional spaces but it is the best method available to our knowledge.
